address: Unit E103, B1F, Velaa Sindhorn Village, 87 Lang Suan Road, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok, 10330, Thailand
bio: Their seasonal menu here is themed around different regions of Thailand, while expertly combining imported European produce with local ingredients. The modern and original interpretations of classic Thai dishes are executed using contemporary techniques and deliver well-judged spicing and layers of texture. There is a casual feel to the dining room, with simple décor and whitewashed walls; there’s a lively open kitchen too, so ensure you sit at the counter to watch the chefs in action....
